attributes.name: icon implementation type
attributes.definition: What kind of graphic or character is used to render icons and icon-like affordances on the page.

values.definition: Icons are plain Unicode text symbols such as arrows or menu characters (e.g. ☰, →), not images, SVG or icon fonts.
Icons or placeholders are rendered with emoji characters.
Icons are SVG, raster images or sprites.
Icons come from an icon font library.
No icons present, or another mechanism.

attributes.name: icon container treatment
attributes.definition: The shape or surface the icon sits on or inside.

values.definition: Icon sits inside a small rounded pill-shaped chip alongside a label.
Icon sits on a solid or tinted square or rounded tile.
Icon sits centered in an image-card area filled with a gradient.
Icon is placed directly in text or a button with no container.
No icon container, or another treatment.

attributes.name: icon-label semantic match
attributes.definition: Whether icons correspond appropriately to the labels or destinations they accompany.

values.definition: Each icon fits its label's meaning.
Icons do not fit their labels or the same icon is repeated across different items.
Icons are not paired with distinguishing labels.

attributes.name: label text case
attributes.definition: Capitalization style of button and link labels.
